description: This file contains helper functions and type definitions for provider onboarding, model configuration, and alias management within a plugin SDK for a larger system. It manages provider model merging, configuration application, and allowlist entries.

methods.name: extractAgentDefaultModelFallbacks
methods.description: Extracts fallback model references from a model object if present.

methods.name: normalizeAgentModelAliasEntry
methods.description: Normalizes an alias entry into an object with modelRef and optional alias.

methods.name: resolveProviderModelMergeState
methods.description: Resolves and returns the current merge state for a provider's models and configurations.

methods.name: buildProviderConfig
methods.description: Constructs a provider configuration object with given parameters, including API key handling.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithMergedModels
methods.description: Applies provider configuration with merged models and updates the overall config.

methods.name: createProviderPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates preset appliers for provider configurations, allowing flexible application of presets.

methods.name: withAgentModelAliases
methods.description: Adds or updates agent model aliases in existing configuration.

methods.name: applyOnboardAuthAgentModelsAndProviders
methods.description: Updates config with specified agent models and provider configurations.

methods.name: applyAgentDefaultModelPrimary
methods.description: Sets the primary model for agent defaults, preserving fallbacks if present.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModels
methods.description: Merges default models into provider configuration, considering existing models and defaults.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModel
methods.description: Applies a single default model to provider configuration.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModelPreset
methods.description: Creates a preset application for provider config with default model and optional primary model ref.

methods.name: createDefaultModelPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates preset appliers for default model configurations.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModelsPreset
methods.description: Creates a preset application for provider config with multiple default models.

methods.name: createDefaultModelsPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates preset appliers for default models.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithModelCatalog
methods.description: Merges catalog models into provider configuration, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithModelCatalogPreset
methods.description: Creates a preset application for provider config with catalog models.

methods.name: createModelCatalogPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates preset appliers for model catalog configurations.

methods.name: ensureModelAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Ensures a model reference is included in the allowlist, adding canonical keys.
